pages.text: In the Nether, seek Darius Emberwright, Seraphine Blackveil, Malric Vane, Cassian Ashfall and Valen Cinderwatch. Their homes generate outside the Infernal Dunes. Incendium’s large biomes make a marked route and spare supplies valuable.

A.U.R.A. preserves the research on the End's outer islands, beyond the dragon-fight island. Prepare for Nullscape terrain. Elyndra, Keeper of the Veil, explains the living tradition behind awakening in Twilight Forest's woodlands and clearings. Follow Twilight's own progression while exploring.
